title: Blue disposable mask held on a dark polished table with University building signage in background
objects_and_counts: One light-blue disposable face mask is visible resting on the table in the foreground; its left and right edges are being held.
Visible parts of one person: two forearms and two hands are visible (right and left forearm/hand), both hands are interacting with the mask; no full faces or additional whole people are visible.
One beaded bracelet with seven visible brown beads is worn on the right wrist (beads are partially obscured by the wrist position).
One large dark, glossy table or countertop occupies the foreground and reflects the scene above it.

Background scene includes one brick wall with text, one planted landscaping strip with shrubs, and at least one tree at upper right; multiple windows and building façades are visible behind the brick wall.

Both hands/forearms emerge from the right side of the frame and grasp the mask’s sides; the right hand is nearest the camera and the left hand is partially visible behind the mask.
The brick wall with the text "THE UNIVERSITY OF HONG KONG" is in the middle-ground, behind the table and landscaping strip.

Windows and building façades form a backdrop above and around the brick wall, spanning the image width behind the courtyard area.
